terraform-capability-pair-review.txt.text:

For example, resource `enable_feature_discovery` and data-source `disable_feature_discovery` incorrectly form a pair, returning “Missing enable or disable choice” and excluding other candidates. Require matching provider name and role before treating them as peers.
